title: dump-pp-eval
summary: Diagnostic dump of preprocessor expression evaluation, paired with dump-pp-lex
intro: Read this only when debugging why a conditional-compilation expression came out true or false: `dump-pp-eval --expr <expr>` with optional --define SYM and --numeric K=V evaluates ONE {$IF} expression and prints true or false. Diagnostic verb, pairs with dump-pp-lex; no index needed.

questions.ask: Does this conditional-compilation expression evaluate true with these defines?

notes: internal: diagnostic: preprocessor expression-evaluation dump. Same pairing as dump-pp-lex.; seed: group guessed
